$comment: Working the advanced topic implicitly practises the simpler one. coverage is the fraction of the simpler topic actually exercised.

encompassings.reason: Constructing a roled message presupposes the request envelope it sits inside.
Reading a response's stop_reason means reading which role produced the turn it's attached to.
Every tool_use exercise re-triggers reading the stop_reason value that announces it.
Choosing among tool_choice values requires re-exercising what a tool_use call is.
Designing a schema is designing the input_schema of a tool_use call.
The loop's single branch point is the stop_reason check, practiced every time the loop is traced.
Configuring an agent means configuring which loop it runs.
A coordinator and a subagent are both AgentDefinitions, re-exercising the same fields.
Spawning a subagent via Task is the hub-and-spoke topology in action.
A hook intercepts a specific step of the same loop this topic re-exercises.
Configuring a server re-exercises what tools/resources/prompts a server provides.
isError is read on the same tool-call shape the overview introduces.
Resources are one of the three primitives being re-exercised.
Using @path means placing content correctly within the same three-level hierarchy.
Choosing .claude/rules/ over a hierarchy level requires knowing the hierarchy it's an alternative to.
The always-on/on-demand contrast re-exercises what CLAUDE.md's always-loaded model actually is.
Deciding what the loop may do re-exercises the loop's own step structure.
Running headless is a specific point on the same direct-execution-vs-planning spectrum.
An explicit criterion is what a well-chosen example was already implicitly demonstrating.
Each chained step still needs the same explicit, falsifiable criteria.
A retry loop is exercised against the same nullable/required schema discipline.
custom_id and failure handling are mechanics of the same batch shape the overview introduces.
Planning a window re-exercises how failures are identified and resubmitted within it.
Fixed-vs-adaptive is the same distinction, generalized from a prompt chain to a task plan.
Multi-pass review is a worked instance of the fixed-pipeline half of that distinction.
Applying an escalation pattern re-exercises which trigger fired.
Building a handoff re-exercises which escalation pattern produced it.
Confidence routing re-exercises why self-rated confidence was ruled out as a trigger.
Spotting an anti-pattern requires re-classifying which error category is being mishandled.
Building a structured error re-exercises exactly what the anti-patterns were missing.
Both re-exercise the same keep-only-what's-load-bearing discipline.
Positioning trimmed content still assumes the trimming step already happened.
Writing a scratchpad re-exercises which findings are worth surfacing prominently.
A state manifest is a scratchpad's structure applied across several agents.
Detecting a conflict re-exercises the same source/date/confidence attribution fields.
Resolving a conflict with a date re-exercises how conflicting values are represented.
The fallback is reached only after the same Grep/Read investigation this topic covers has been run.
